items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: December 18th, 1933, I will never forget Fletcher Henderson's band coming to Kansas City... when Fletcher walked in and when they walked in and heard that band

ctx.x: Bennie Moten was a great pianist, wasn't he?

Bennie Moten was the greatest bandleader that ever lived. Whenever you saw piano; whenever you saw a Fletcher Henderson; whenever you saw a Cab Calloway; whenever you saw a Duke Ellington... - that's Bennie Moten. You see Basie, that's Bennie Moten. The greatest bandleader; he covered the whole sphere. Everybody thought Jimmy Rushing was Bennie Moten when they came to New York in 1930 and 1932, but he was Mr. Moten.
